steps.code:
spotify_access_token = spotify_token['access_token']
liked_songs = []
page = 0
while True:
    result = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=spotify_access_token, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not result:
        break
    liked_songs.extend(result)
    if len(result) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
print(len(liked_songs))
print(liked_songs[:3])

        # Remove leading "- " and trailing " RELEASED_AT TODO"
        song_part = line[2:].replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '').strip()
        # Split on " BY " to get title and artists
        if ' BY ' in song_part:
            title, artists = song_part.split(' BY ', 1)
            key = (title.strip(), artists.strip())
            if key in song_release_map:
                release_date = song_release_map[key]
                # Extract month and year
                year = release_date[:4]
                month = release_date[5:7]
                new_release = f"{month}/{year}"
                new_line = f"- {title} BY {artists} RELEASED_AT {new_release}"
                new_lines.append(new_line)
            else:

                new_lines.append(line)
        else:
